name: Sakurao Gin Limited
production: All 17 botanicals sourced from land and sea around Hiroshima
history: 1918 | Chugoku Jozo founded (also known for Togouchi whisky)
2018 | Sakurao Distillery opens in Hiroshima; Sakurao Gin Original and Limited released (March 2018)
expressions: Sakurao Gin Original | 9 Hiroshima botanicals, entry-level
notes: Launch price in Japan 5,500 yen before tax (Nomunication, 2018). Nomunication lists 16 named botanicals for 17 total. Tasting notes from Master of Malt (retailer), not producer.
